text:
Eli: Heads-up — deploying quantized-runtime v2 to staging at 10:30 PT (in ~30m). This includes KV cache TTL bump, small scheduler tweak, and observability changes: new Grafana panels for per-model cache hit rate + p95 latency, increased trace sampling for decode spans, and tightened alert thresholds. Who's on deploy and smoke checks? Rollback criteria: error rate > 1% for 5m OR p50 latency regression > 150ms. @Marta you asked for the dashboard updates, @Sanjay can you run the synthetic smoke suite? :eyes:

Marta: I'll own dashboards. Pushing a new dashboard JSON (panel ids changed). I'll update Prom rules for the cache-hit alert and add a p95 latency panel. I'll be watching during the window. Will annotate changelog with the panel diffs. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay: I can run the smoke-suite and synthetic prompts once staging is live. I'll run the end-to-end prompt runner and a 200 qps load for 2m. Link to the test harness: https://staging-tests.internal/queues/quant-v2 — I'll paste results here. If any prompt fails semantic checks >0.5% we abort.

Jo: I'll handle trace sampling and dashboards for decode spans. Increasing sampling to 50% for decode/kv spans during rollout window only. If we observe CPU on any host >85% for 1m, we'll cut traffic. Also will add a trace tag `deploy=quant-v2` for easy filtering.

OpsBot: Canary pipeline triggered by Eli at 1769954321. Canary plan: 10% traffic -> 3min monitor -> escalate to 50% if no errors -> full rollout after 15m of healthy signals. Automated rollback if alert fires.

DevEx Bot: Reminder — add the rollout note to #releases and tag the SDK changelog. Suggested changelog snippet: "runtime: quantized v2 deployed to staging; observability updates to cache/p95 panels"

Ben: Quick CR note: PR #2468 modifies TTL and config flags for quantized runtime; I approved. Preparing a short rollback playbook (adding exact commands for rollback and tag to revert image).

Marta: Prometheus alert rule I'll push is small — sample below, will go to staging alert group:
```yaml
- alert: CacheHitRateLow
  expr: (sum by (model) (cache_hits_total) / sum by (model) (cache_requests_total)) < 0.6
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Cache hit rate low for {{ $labels.model }}"
    runbook: https://wiki/release-runbooks/quant-v2
```

Eli: Thanks all. Timeline: deploy start 10:30 PT, canary -> 10:43 PT decision, full rollout target 11:00 PT. I'll be performing the canary trigger. Post-rollout tasks: Marta will commit panel IDs, Jo will drop sampling back to default, Ben will close the changelog.

Sanjay: I'll post the smoke-suite results here when done.

Jo: I'll post a trace link and CPU snapshots.

Ben: Rollback playbook prep link: https://confluence.internal/playbooks/rollback-quant-v2 (will update with exact image tags once build finishes).

Eli: If nobody objects, proceeding as planned. :rocket: (reaction:thumbsup)

Marta: 👍

Sanjay: 👍

Jo: 👍

OpsBot: Canary completed: 10%->50% success, no alerts fired during monitoring window (summary available in pipeline). (reaction:party)
